issue: Price-range minimum filter does not correctly exclude products below the selected minimum threshold
actual: On /products with Filters open, setting the price range minimum to $710 (via ARIA slider, PageUp steps) still showed Breville Barista Express ($699) in results despite being below the minimum. Increasing minimum to $810 still showed Dyson V15 Detect ($749). Bug reproduced independent of the rating filter (cleared rating to "Any" and defect persisted). Sort by price (Low-High/High-Low) and rating filter (4+/4.5+) worked correctly in isolation.
evidence: Reproduced twice with different thresholds; isolated from rating filter interference.

Category dropdown/listbox in Create Product form was opened and enumerated; exactly 3 options present (Tech Gadgets, Home Goods, Fitness), matching the constraint that categories are limited to tech gadgets, home goods, and fitness.

issue: Filtered product results do not strictly match selected price-range minimum criterion
actual: With price range minimum set to $710, Breville Barista Express ($699, below minimum) was incorrectly included in results. evidence: Reproduced twice at two different thresholds ($710 min showed $699 item; $810 min showed $749 item).

Product list on /products updated immediately (no reload, no lag) upon each filter/sort/search change (category, rating, price slider, tags, search box), confirming real-time UI updates. Correctness of the price-filter results is a separate defect already captured under CS-12/FT-10.
"Clear all filters" button in the Filters panel resets category, price range, rating, tags, and search state back to defaults, restoring full unfiltered product list.

Inspected Buy Now anchor element via browser_evaluate: target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" confirmed, ensuring external navigation opens safely in a new tab without exposing the referring window.

Product detail pages display a distinct short description (card/hero) and a separate, more detailed "My Review" full-review section, both populated with coherent, product-specific written content (e.g., Breville Barista Express review text).
